[color=#ffff00][head=3]Jobs[/head][/color] The current factions are the Triad Defence Force (TDF) and Triad Frontier Association (TFA). The TFA is all staff working for Venmar, Edison and Medical Dispatch.
[color=#a4885c]IJ.1[/color] If you choose a Command, or Faction role, you are required to participate in the round as that role for the duration of the shift.. Do not change roles without sufficient IC justification. ★
[color=#a4885c]IJ.2[/color] You are required to prioritise your roles and responsibilities. You must respond and return to your duties. IC situations such as kidnapping, death or similar mitigate this rule. ★
[color=#a4885c]IJ.3[/color] Characters in Command, or Faction roles must be the sort of character that could reasonably have attained their position and can reasonably perform their duties. This includes knowing and understanding rules that your faction has in place. ★
[color=#a4885c]IJ.4[/color] If you are playing a character with disabilities in a position that other players rely on, it is your responsibility to ensure that you and your character can work around those barriers. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
